Name: Abiathar, Priest
Summary: Abiathar, who had carried the ephod for David, sided with Adonijah against Solomon, and Solomon thrust him out of the priesthood, fulfilling the word against Eli's house, though he spared his life because he had borne the ark.
KeyStory: Abiathar sides with Adonijah and is deposed.
RelatedPeople: King David; King Solomon; Zadok, High Priest; Jonathan, Son of Abiathar
LifeLesson: A lifetime of service does not excuse one disloyal choice at the decisive hour.
